utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot—once I know the timing and what to bring, I can see if I’ll make it. I’m just still a little worried about pickup and where everything gets stored.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can ask Cleo about pickup and storage, then let you know the timing and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that would really help. Once you hear back, I can figure out whether I can make it and bring the right things.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, definitely—if you can come by this weekend, there’s still plenty to do, and any extra hands would really help. Just bring anything broken or a few supplies, and I’ll point you where they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Tess—I’ll spread the word and tell folks to drop by this weekend. If you send me the timing and any must-bring items, I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful—tell them to come by this weekend with any broken items, and if they can, a few labels or basic supplies would help too. I’ll make sure they know where to head when they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it’s going pretty well so far—lots of folks are pitching in, right? Let me know if you still need another set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It is going well, thanks — and I’d definitely welcome another set of hands. I can pass along what’s still needed if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I’m happy to help—just pass along what’s still needed and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure everyone’s in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — I’ll probably be a bit late, but I’ll still help out once I get there. If you or Cleo need me to bring something, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ll let everyone know, and if we need anything I’ll tell you and Cleo. Glad you’re still coming to help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ve got the taps, door handles, and shelves noted, and I’ll be there Saturday morning at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—Saturday morning works for me. Just send me the spot and I’ll handle the porch light first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — I’ll send you the exact spot once I confirm it, and then you can start with the porch light first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Kira — we’re in good shape so far, and I’m just lining up a few more volunteers and supplies before we get started.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — is that confirmed yet, or are we still lining things up?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re still lining a few things up, but it’s moving in the right direction. Once I’ve got the last volunteers and supplies set, I’ll send the go-ahead.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep the repair drive simple: Saturday morning, a short look, and then we’ll list the main fixes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Eli — Saturday morning works for me. I can help review the fixes and jot down anything we need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great—Saturday morning it is. We’ll keep it brief, make the list, and stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 still works for me—I can help spread the word and keep it clear of pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Faye — what’s still left on the repair list?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m checking the list now — I’ll send you the items I know about and we can make sure they’re all labeled for 4:30.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — I’m still hoping someone spots those hand tools, cords, or a sturdy ladder. I’ve got a short list somewhere, I just need to keep it from wandering off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye out and note if anyone sees them; if you want, I can also help you match the list to the repair drive spot over by the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be great, Opal — thanks. If you can help me match the list to the community center parking lot spot, I’m less likely to lose track of it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out and about, so I’ll keep an eye out for those items and let you know if I find anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate you keeping an eye out. I’ll try to stay on top of it this time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll keep watching for hand tools, extension cords, and a sturdy ladder while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mara — I’ve got the list handy, and I’m checking what’s still missing now. If you can bring tools or a spare part, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can do that—I'll bring my toolbox and see if I have any spare taps or shelf brackets. Thanks for checking the list, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Mara — toolbox, taps, and shelf brackets will cover a lot. I’ll keep checking what’s still missing and let you know if we need anything simple.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Leo — I’ve got tools I can lend for the repair drive, just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — a screwdriver set and a drill would help most. If you’ve got a flashlight too, I can use that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — I’ve got a screwdriver set, a drill, and a flashlight you can borrow. I’ll set them aside for you; just swing by when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll spread the word and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that would be a big help. I’ll share the update sheet and the current list of supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Rosa — I’ll pass it along to everyone and keep the repair drive plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Pia — just keep me posted on the location and any time changes, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — I will. I just need the final pickup time and a clear spot for drop-off so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s make it Saturday morning at 9, and I’ll use the usual drop-off spot by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No worries, Nell — I can still lend a hand if you need it, just keeping it quiet today.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s kind of you, Uli — I’ll pass that along. Sounds like things are still moving along nicely with the drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Glad to hear it — just let me know if anything comes up, and I’ll keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Kira — if you spot any old hand tools, extension cords, or a sturdy ladder, that’d be a huge help. I’m a little scattered today, so I appreciate you keeping an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still going on today, right? I’ll keep an eye out and confirm if I find any of those.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, it’s still going today — thanks, Kira. Just let me know if you spot anything, and I’ll keep it simple from there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got the list and drop-off covered. Can you start sorting donations when you get here?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can start sorting donations when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks — I’ll let you know where to stack the sorted boxes when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — send me the update, and I’ll keep spreading the word to both groups.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m still out running errands, and I’ll keep an eye out for hand tools, extension cords, and a sturdy ladder.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep sharing that list with both groups and let folks know those items are top priority.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course — if you need anything else for the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — I’ll send along the list of repairs and the Saturday morning details if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’m happy to help if anything comes up, so just send the details my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mina — I’ll check what’s still missing and keep it simple for you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Cleo—could you tell me the list as soon as you check it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll check the list now and let you know the missing basics right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s still by the community center parking lot, past the library. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect—thanks for keeping me posted, Opal. I’ll tell folks to head to the community center parking lot and bring anything broken they want looked at.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye on it and flag any changes right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. I’ll try to keep up this time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No pressure at all, Noah — just come by whenever you can, and I can send over the timing and a quick list of helpful stuff to bring.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — that’d help a lot. Send me the timing and list when you can, and I’ll do my best to make it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Faye — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Just tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great—if you can start by setting up the drop-off table around 4:30, that would help a lot. I’ll spread the word and keep it clear of pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll set up the drop-off table around 4:30 and keep it ready. Just let me know if there’s anything else you need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks — if you see what’s still missing, just let me know and I’ll grab something on the way over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the list first and tell you what’s still missing before Saturday morning at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out and grab one of the missing items on my way over.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
